description: The community health of the channel: the success rate, the failure reasons and the affected environments. It tells 'the channel is off the air' from 'the channel is blocked in your country'. `geo` tells whether it is a regional restriction or a general failure (with the countries), `regions[]` has the success and the failure by country, `latency[]` has the opening speed measured at the hop by country, and `pra_voce` sums it up for the country of the caller. Without community reports (`POST /api/play-report`), the panel is empty.

id.description: Channel ID in the catalog, for example `GloboNews.br`.
